summary: The ERP system offers a wide array of inventory reports designed to provide insights into stock levels, item movements, and overall inventory status. These reports include current stock, closing stock, item-specific reports, and stock transfer reports, which are essential for analysis and decision-making.
business_rules: Reports are generated based on all recorded inventory transactions (purchases, transfers, sales, etc.).
important_notes: The system provides a comprehensive suite of reports, allowing users to analyze inventory data according to their specific needs.
Examples of available reports include: Stock Status, Closing Stock, Item-wise Stock, and Stock Transfer reports.
